# Universe (`universe`)

The solar system in 3D, with Earth's real day and night.

- Type: scene (draws its own image; put it first)
- Reacts to: sun, location
- Cost: heavy (~7.2 ms/frame at 5K on a Pro GPU)
- Built-in styles: Universe

| `speed` | Speed | slider | 0 … 3 | 1 |
| `stars` | Stars | slider | 0 … 2 | 1 |
| `planets` | Planet Speed | slider | 0 … 3 | 1 |
| `orbits` | Orbit Lines | toggle | 0 / 1 | on |
| `tilt` | Camera Tilt | slider | 8 … 80 | 24 |
| `spin` | Camera Orbit | slider | -2 … 2 | 1 |
